verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a serverless platform could offer per-developer or preview environments. The evidence only glancingly touches it. A local workerd-powered simulator lets each developer develop and test Workers in isolation (cloudflare-gh-1), and Wrangler handles creating and deploying Workers (cloudflare-docs-20). The Sandbox SDK spins up isolated containers keyed by ID, but these are for running untrusted code in apps, not team ship environments. Missing for 10: documented preview/staging or per-branch environments, any statement of unlimited environment counts, team-parallel deploy workflows, and independent corroboration.
